text:
maria.s (support): heads up — customer Acct:7421 reports dashboard shows ~1,250,000 tokens for Feb 28 cutoff but invoice 7421-2026-02 totals 1,020,342 tokens. customer is asking for explanation and possible credit :eyes:

aj.b (billing): thanks — do we have raw usage export? ask them to share invoice id and a CSV export from the dashboard (Export -> Usage CSV) if possible.

maria.s (support): invoice id attached in thread: 7421-2026-02. customer pasted dashboard CSV snapshot (not full export). says most of the delta sits on 02/28 between 23:30-23:59 UTC.

serge.m (eng-metrics): @maria.s can you pull the canonical usage aggregate we use for invoicing? run this on prod-metrics: 
```
SELECT event_date, SUM(token_count) as tokens, COUNT(*) as calls
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id = '7421' AND event_date BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28'
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date;
```
I can run if you give me the request id.

maria.s (support): thanks — attaching request ids from customer logs: rq_9a7c, rq_9a7d, rq_9a7e (all around 2026-02-28T23:46:xxZ).

serge.m (eng-metrics): ran the query. DB shows 1,020,342 tokens for Feb total (matches invoice). Dashboard export tool is returning 1,249,990 tokens — looks like dashboard is double-counting some streaming chunks for that time window.

lina.k (acct-mgr): important — customer is on growth-plan-v2 which has tiered pricing, the invoice tier boundaries change credit amounts. If dashboard double-count pushed them into a higher displayed tier, they thought they'd be charged more, so they disputed when invoice looked lower. we need to be clear in customer comms.

aj.b (billing): confirmed invoice numbers are correct. We should offer pro-rated credit of the perceived overage for goodwill. But root cause needs fix.

serge.m (eng-metrics): quick root cause: a retry loop in the streaming aggregator service would re-emit partial chunk tokens to the dashboard export when re-processing late-arriving events. The invoicing pipeline deduplicates by event_id but dashboard export missed that dedupe for streaming partials. Fix is to apply same dedupe key (event_id) in dashboard exporter.

maria.s (support): can you estimate impact window and whether any other customers affected? customer wants confirmation and a short timeline.

serge.m (eng-metrics): impact looks limited to Feb 28 23:00-00:15 UTC and only accounts with long-running streaming sessions (we found 11 accounts). I created a patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metrics/pull/3812 — will deploy to staging for test then prod.

aj.b (billing): alex from accounting — prepare manual credits for 11 accounts flagged by serge, but wait until we verify counts. If invoice already paid, issue credit memo referencing invoice 7421-2026-02.

maria.s (support): messaging for customer: "Thanks — we investigated. Invoice is correct (1,020,342 tokens). Dashboard export incorrectly double-counted streaming partials for a brief window; we're rolling a fix and will issue a credit if the dashboard caused any billing confusion. Apologies for the noise. We'll follow up when fix is live and provide a corrected dashboard CSV." ok to send?

lina.k (acct-mgr): ok with that, add: "We verified only a small set of accounts were affected; we will issue a credit where appropriate and proactively notify impacted customers."

serge.m (eng-metrics): deployment plan in PR notes: staging smoke (10m) -> prod canary (5%) -> full roll. ETA: 3 hours staging, 1 hour canary, 2 hours full rollout. Post-deploy run the dedupe recompute for the export and regenerate CSV for impacted accounts. Command to regenerate: 
```
python tools/recompute_dashboard_export.py --account 7421 --from 2026-02-28 --to 2026-02-28 --dedupe-by event_id
```

billing-bot: credit-memo-created invoice=7421-2026-02 memo_id=CM-9872 amount=0.00 reason="pending verification"

maria.s (support): I'll send the customer the suggested message + hold credit pending verification. tagging @lina.k and @aj.b for final approval before I send. :thumbsup:   

aj.b (billing): approved. proceed.

lina.k (acct-mgr): approved. please include timeline and that we'll share a corrected CSV after recompute.

maria.s (support): sent message to customer, they replied "Thanks for fast follow-up, we'll wait for corrected CSV and any credit memo." closing here, will update once recompute job completes.

serge.m (eng-metrics): post-deploy note: recompute ran, corrected CSV for 7421 shows 1,020,342 tokens. I uploaded to s3://redwood-exports/7421/2026-02-corrected.csv and flagged accounts.csv.

maria.s (support): confirmed customer downloaded corrected CSV and acknowledged. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
